In formal process semantics, this requires a stateful router or an XOR gateway preceding the loop target to resolve routing deterministically. 3. **Gateway Optimization:** Merge the sequential approval decisions into a single compound XOR gate: `Approval Required & Granted?` to reduce intermediate token states and clarify the control graph.
